_comment: Shared Excel-semantics case table for the PlexiSum formula engines.
Committed to plexichat as src/tests/suite/formula_parity_cases.json and to
copies must stay byte-identical: each engine is tested against the copy it
ships, and every expected value is what Excel returns, so either engine
drifting from Excel (or from the other engine) fails a test.
Types are explicit (number:/text:/boolean:/error:/blank/array) so a text "12" is
never mistaken for the number 12. An array value (a matrix-returning
function such as FREQUENCY) is written as array: followed by its typed
The cells listed below hold the fixture data; an unlisted cell is blank.
A range in a scalar slot follows the pooled-argument rule: a one-cell
range is that cell, an error cell propagates, and more than one cell is
A fixed-arity call rejects a stray argument (#VALUE!) before it evaluates
any operand, so a wrong count beats an error operand; an error operand
otherwise propagates out of every value function. AND/OR read a range cell
by cell and OFFSET propagates an error written into its lazy offsets. The
cases at the end pin those rules.
